svg.title: Fjord at golden hour, painted by GPT-6.1 Terra in Kleki
svg.desc: A fjord with ridges fading into blue haze, a low sun with a wide glow, a broken shimmer on the water and dark pines in front. 1611 input actions over 64 minutes, 170 screenshots, owner kleki-terra.
